ingredients: paneer, tomatoes, onion, ginger, garlic, cashews, butter, fresh cream, kashmiri red chilli powder, garam masala, kasuri methi, sugar, salt
instructions: Boil tomatoes, onion, ginger, garlic and cashews in a cup of water for 12 minutes, cool and blend to a smooth puree. Strain the puree for a silky texture. Heat butter, add the puree and cook on medium heat for 8 minutes until it thickens and the raw smell disappears. Stir in chilli powder, garam masala, sugar and salt. Add cream and half a cup of water, simmer 3 minutes. Fold in cubed paneer and crushed kasuri methi, cook 2 more minutes and rest before serving.

ingredients: chickpeas, onion, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, green chilli, cumin seeds, coriander powder, turmeric, amchur, garam masala, oil, salt, coriander leaves
instructions: Soak chickpeas overnight and pressure cook with salt for 5 whistles until soft. Heat oil, crackle cumin seeds, then saute finely chopped onion until deep golden. Add ginger garlic paste and green chilli, cook 1 minute. Add pureed tomatoes with turmeric and coriander powder and fry until the oil separates. Add the cooked chickpeas with a cup of their cooking water, mash a few with the ladle to thicken the gravy, and simmer 15 minutes. Finish with amchur, garam masala and chopped coriander.

ingredients: potatoes, cumin seeds, green chilli, turmeric, red chilli powder, amchur, oil, salt, coriander leaves
instructions: Boil potatoes until just tender, peel and cut into cubes. Heat oil in a wide pan and crackle cumin seeds. Add slit green chilli and turmeric, then add the potato cubes. Toss gently on medium-high heat for 8 to 10 minutes until the edges are crisp and golden. Sprinkle red chilli powder, amchur and salt, toss once more and finish with coriander leaves.

ingredients: spinach, paneer, onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, green chilli, cumin seeds, garam masala, cream, butter, salt
instructions: Blanch spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes, transfer to ice water, then blend with green chilli to a coarse puree. Heat butter, crackle cumin, saute onion until soft, add ginger garlic and cook until fragrant. Add chopped tomato and cook down for 5 minutes. Pour in the spinach puree, season with salt and garam masala and simmer 6 minutes without covering so the colour stays bright. Add lightly pan-seared paneer cubes and a swirl of cream, and take off the heat after 2 minutes.

ingredients: dosa rice, urad dal, fenugreek seeds, potatoes, onion, mustard seeds, curry leaves, turmeric, green chilli, oil, salt
instructions: Soak rice and urad dal with fenugreek separately for 5 hours, grind to a smooth batter, mix with salt and ferment overnight. For the filling, temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil, add sliced onion and green chilli, saute until soft, add turmeric and mashed boiled potatoes with salt. Heat a flat tawa, spread a ladle of batter thin in a spiral, drizzle oil around the edges and cook until crisp and golden. Place the potato filling in the centre, fold and serve hot with chutney and sambar.

ingredients: basmati rice, carrot, beans, cauliflower, peas, onion, curd, ginger, garlic, mint, coriander, biryani masala, whole spices, saffron, milk, ghee, salt
instructions: Soak basmati rice for 30 minutes. Fry sliced onion in ghee until crisp and set aside. Marinate the chopped vegetables in curd with ginger garlic paste, biryani masala, mint and salt for 20 minutes. Boil water with whole spices, cook the rice to 70 percent and drain. Cook the marinated vegetables in a heavy pot for 8 minutes, layer the rice over them, scatter fried onion, herbs and saffron soaked in warm milk. Seal the pot and cook on the lowest heat for 20 minutes, then rest 10 minutes before opening.

ingredients: kidney beans, onion, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, bay leaf, cumin seeds, coriander powder, turmeric, red chilli powder, garam masala, oil, salt
instructions: Soak kidney beans for 8 hours and pressure cook with a bay leaf and salt for 6 whistles until completely soft. Heat oil, crackle cumin, brown the chopped onion well, then add ginger garlic paste. Add tomato puree with turmeric, coriander and chilli powder and fry until the masala leaves the sides of the pan. Add the beans with their stock, mash a ladleful for body and simmer 20 minutes until the gravy is creamy. Finish with garam masala and serve with steamed rice.

ingredients: basmati rice, carrot, peas, beans, onion, cumin seeds, bay leaf, cinnamon, cloves, green chilli, ghee, salt, coriander leaves
instructions: Soak rice 20 minutes and drain. Heat ghee in a pressure cooker, add cumin, bay leaf, cinnamon and cloves. Add sliced onion and green chilli and saute until translucent. Add the diced vegetables and toss for 3 minutes. Add the drained rice, salt and one and a half cups water per cup of rice. Pressure cook for 2 whistles, rest 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork and garnish with coriander.

ingredients: wheat flour, potatoes, green chilli, ginger, coriander leaves, amchur, red chilli powder, ajwain, ghee, salt
instructions: Knead wheat flour with water and salt into a soft dough and rest 20 minutes. Mash boiled potatoes with chopped green chilli, ginger, coriander, amchur, chilli powder, ajwain and salt, keeping the filling dry. Roll a small disc of dough, place a ball of filling in the centre, gather the edges and seal. Dust with flour and roll gently into a paratha. Cook on a hot tawa, smearing ghee on both sides, until golden brown spots appear. Serve with curd and pickle.

ingredients: toor dal, turmeric, tomato, onion, garlic, dried red chilli, cumin seeds, asafoetida, ghee, salt, coriander leaves
instructions: Pressure cook toor dal with turmeric, chopped tomato and salt for 4 whistles, then whisk until creamy. In a small pan heat ghee, crackle cumin seeds, add sliced garlic and dried red chilli and fry until the garlic is golden. Add a pinch of asafoetida and immediately pour the tempering over the hot dal. Cover for a minute to trap the aroma, stir through and finish with coriander leaves.

ingredients: semolina, onion, carrot, peas, green chilli, ginger, mustard seeds, urad dal, chana dal, curry leaves, oil, salt, lemon juice
instructions: Dry roast semolina on low heat for 5 minutes until it smells nutty and set aside. Heat oil, splutter mustard seeds, add urad dal and chana dal and fry until golden. Add curry leaves, green chilli, ginger and onion and saute until soft. Add diced carrot and peas with salt and two and a half cups of water per cup of semolina and bring to a rolling boil. Lower the heat and rain in the semolina while stirring continuously to avoid lumps. Cover and steam 3 minutes, then finish with lemon juice.

ingredients: flattened rice, onion, potato, green chilli, curry leaves, mustard seeds, turmeric, peanuts, sugar, salt, lemon juice, coriander leaves
instructions: Rinse flattened rice in a colander until just softened, sprinkle with salt, sugar and turmeric and set aside to fluff up. Heat oil, fry peanuts until crunchy and remove. Splutter mustard seeds, add curry leaves, green chilli, diced potato and cook covered until the potato is tender. Add sliced onion and saute until translucent. Fold in the soaked poha gently, cover and steam on low for 3 minutes. Finish with peanuts, lemon juice and coriander.

ingredients: idli rice, urad dal, fenugreek seeds, salt, coconut, roasted chana dal, green chilli, ginger, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil
instructions: Soak idli rice and urad dal with fenugreek separately for 5 hours. Grind urad dal to a light fluffy paste and rice to a slightly coarse batter, mix with salt and ferment 8 to 10 hours until doubled. Pour into greased idli moulds and steam 10 to 12 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. For the chutney blend coconut, roasted chana dal, green chilli and ginger with water and salt, then temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil and pour over.

ingredients: toor dal, drumstick, pumpkin, brinjal, onion, tomato, tamarind, sambar powder, turmeric, mustard seeds, curry leaves, asafoetida, oil, salt
instructions: Pressure cook toor dal with turmeric until soft and mash smooth. Boil the chopped vegetables with tamarind extract, salt and sambar powder until tender, about 12 minutes. Add the mashed dal with enough water to reach a pouring consistency and simmer 10 minutes so the flavours settle. Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and asafoetida in oil and pour into the sambar. Serve with rice, idli or dosa.

ingredients: rice, moong dal, carrot, peas, beans, cumin seeds, ginger, turmeric, asafoetida, ghee, salt
instructions: Rinse rice and moong dal together until the water runs clear. Heat ghee in a pressure cooker, crackle cumin seeds, add grated ginger and a pinch of asafoetida. Add the diced vegetables and saute 2 minutes. Add the rice, dal, turmeric, salt and four cups of water for each cup of grain mix. Pressure cook 4 whistles and let the pressure release naturally. Stir well to a soft porridge consistency and serve with a spoon of ghee and curd.

ingredients: brinjal, onion, tomatoes, green chilli, ginger, garlic, cumin seeds, coriander powder, red chilli powder, mustard oil, salt, coriander leaves
instructions: Rub a large brinjal with oil, slit it and roast directly over an open flame until the skin blisters and the flesh collapses, about 12 minutes, turning often. Cool, peel off the charred skin and mash the smoky flesh. Heat mustard oil, crackle cumin, saute onion until golden, then add ginger, garlic and green chilli. Add chopped tomatoes with coriander and chilli powder and cook until pulpy. Stir in the mashed brinjal with salt and cook 10 minutes on medium heat, stirring often. Finish with coriander leaves.

ingredients: paneer, green peas, onion, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, cashews, cumin seeds, coriander powder, turmeric, garam masala, oil, salt
instructions: Blend onion, tomatoes, ginger, garlic and cashews into a smooth paste. Heat oil, crackle cumin seeds and add the paste, cooking on medium heat for 10 minutes until it thickens and darkens. Add turmeric, coriander powder and salt and fry another 2 minutes. Add green peas with a cup of water and simmer 8 minutes until the peas are tender. Add paneer cubes and garam masala, simmer 3 minutes and rest before serving with roti.

ingredients: tea leaves, milk, water, ginger, green cardamom, cloves, black pepper, sugar
instructions: Crush ginger, cardamom, cloves and black pepper coarsely in a mortar. Bring water to a boil with the crushed spices and let them infuse for 3 minutes. Add tea leaves and boil 2 minutes until the colour deepens. Pour in milk and sugar and bring to a boil, lowering the heat each time it rises, repeating three times for a full-bodied brew. Strain into cups and serve immediately.

ingredients: cooked rice, carrot, capsicum, cabbage, spring onion, garlic, soy sauce, vinegar, white pepper, oil, salt
instructions: Use rice cooked and cooled at least a few hours ahead so the grains stay separate. Heat oil in a wok until smoking, add chopped garlic and stir for 20 seconds. Add the finely diced vegetables and stir fry on the highest heat for 3 minutes so they stay crunchy. Add the rice and toss constantly, breaking up clumps. Splash soy sauce and vinegar around the edge of the wok, season with white pepper and salt, and finish with spring onion greens.

ingredients: noodles, carrot, capsicum, cabbage, spring onion, garlic, soy sauce, vinegar, chilli sauce, black pepper, oil, salt
instructions: Boil noodles in salted water until just done, drain, rinse under cold water and toss with a teaspoon of oil. Heat oil in a wok on high, add chopped garlic and stir briefly. Add julienned carrot, capsicum and cabbage and stir fry 3 minutes keeping them crisp. Add soy sauce, vinegar, chilli sauce and pepper, then add the noodles and toss with two forks to coat evenly. Finish with spring onion greens and serve hot.

ingredients: pizza dough, canned tomatoes, mozzarella, fresh basil, garlic, olive oil, salt
instructions: Bring the dough to room temperature and preheat the oven with a baking tray inside at the highest setting for 30 minutes. Blend canned tomatoes with a clove of garlic, olive oil and salt for an uncooked sauce. Stretch the dough by hand into a thin round leaving a thicker rim. Spread a thin layer of sauce, scatter torn mozzarella and slide onto the hot tray. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until the crust is blistered and the cheese bubbles. Finish with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil.

ingredients: pasta, canned tomatoes, garlic, dried red chilli, olive oil, salt, parsley
instructions: Boil pasta in generously salted water until one minute short of al dente, reserving a cup of the cooking water. Heat olive oil on low and infuse sliced garlic and crushed dried chilli until the garlic turns pale gold, without browning. Add crushed tomatoes and salt and simmer 12 minutes until thick. Add the drained pasta with a splash of pasta water and toss vigorously for a minute so the sauce clings. Finish with chopped parsley and a drizzle of olive oil.

ingredients: chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, red onion, parsley, lemon juice, olive oil, cumin powder, black pepper, salt
instructions: Drain and rinse cooked chickpeas thoroughly and pat dry. Dice cucumber, tomato and red onion to a similar small size so every spoonful is balanced. Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, cumin powder, salt and pepper into a dressing. Toss everything with chopped parsley and let the bowl sit 10 minutes so the onion softens and the flavours mingle. Serve chilled as a light lunch or side.

ingredients: chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, cumin powder, salt, ice water
instructions: Cook soaked chickpeas with a pinch of baking soda until they are very soft and the skins slip off easily. Blend the warm chickpeas with garlic, lemon juice, tahini, cumin and salt. With the blender running, drizzle in ice water a spoon at a time until the hummus turns pale and fluffy. Adjust salt and lemon, then spread in a bowl, make a well with the back of a spoon and pour over olive oil.

ingredients: eggs, onion, tomato, green chilli, coriander leaves, turmeric, black pepper, oil, salt
instructions: Beat the eggs with salt, pepper and a pinch of turmeric until slightly frothy. Stir in finely chopped onion, tomato, green chilli and coriander. Heat oil in a non stick pan on medium heat and pour in the mixture, tilting to spread evenly. Cook undisturbed for 2 minutes until the base is set and golden, then fold in half and cook another minute. Serve with buttered toast.

ingredients: chicken thighs, curd, tomatoes, onion, ginger, garlic, cashews, butter, cream, kashmiri red chilli powder, garam masala, kasuri methi, salt
instructions: Marinate chicken in curd, ginger garlic paste, chilli powder and salt for at least an hour, then grill or pan sear until charred at the edges. Simmer tomatoes, onion, cashews, ginger and garlic in water for 15 minutes and blend to a smooth strained puree. Cook the puree in butter for 10 minutes until it thickens and deepens in colour. Add chilli powder, salt, cream and a little water and simmer 5 minutes. Add the seared chicken, crushed kasuri methi and garam masala and simmer 8 minutes until the sauce coats the pieces.

ingredients: boiled eggs, onion, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, green chilli, cumin seeds, turmeric, coriander powder, red chilli powder, garam masala, oil, salt, coriander leaves
instructions: Halve or prick the boiled eggs and shallow fry them with a pinch of turmeric and salt until lightly golden, then set aside. Heat oil, crackle cumin seeds and brown the chopped onion. Add ginger garlic paste and green chilli, then tomato puree with turmeric, coriander and chilli powder. Cook until the oil separates from the masala. Add two cups of water and simmer 10 minutes, then slide in the eggs and cook 5 minutes more. Finish with garam masala and coriander leaves.

ingredients: tomatoes, onion, garlic, carrot, butter, bay leaf, black pepper, sugar, cream, salt
instructions: Melt butter and saute chopped onion, garlic and carrot with a bay leaf for 6 minutes until soft but not browned. Add roughly chopped ripe tomatoes, salt and two cups of water and simmer 20 minutes until everything collapses. Remove the bay leaf and blend until smooth, then pass through a sieve for a velvety texture. Return to the pan, adjust with pepper, a pinch of sugar and a little water, and simmer 5 minutes. Swirl in cream just before serving with croutons.

ingredients: bread, potato, cucumber, tomato, onion, butter, green chutney, chaat masala, black pepper, salt
instructions: Boil and slice a potato, and thinly slice cucumber, tomato and onion. Butter both slices of bread generously to the edges and spread green chutney on one side. Layer the potato first, then cucumber, tomato and onion, seasoning each layer lightly with salt, pepper and chaat masala. Close the sandwich, press gently and either serve fresh or toast in a sandwich press until golden and crisp. Cut diagonally and serve with ketchup.

ingredients: semolina, ghee, sugar, water, cardamom powder, cashews, raisins, saffron
instructions: Heat ghee and fry cashews and raisins until golden, then remove and set aside. Add semolina to the same ghee and roast on low heat for 10 minutes, stirring constantly, until it turns light golden and aromatic. Separately boil water with sugar, cardamom and saffron until the sugar dissolves. Pour the hot syrup into the roasted semolina carefully as it will splutter, stirring continuously to prevent lumps. Cook 4 minutes until the halwa thickens and leaves the sides of the pan, then fold in the fried nuts and rest covered for 5 minutes.
